verdict.rationale: Better Auth is a self-hosted TypeScript auth framework. Asking whether user data could be used for AI training is still a fair privacy-posture question for auth products, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documented AI-training opt-out, data-use policy, or no-training commitment. Community remarks that users store auth data in their own database describe a deployment arrangement, not a documented no-training control, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
